data.long_meaning: From the Hebrew shama, which means 'to hear'. This name is derived from the biblical character Simon Peter. It was given to him because he was a listener, being the first to hear Jesus' words and follow them. The name Szymon carries the meaning “God listens” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Szymon usually hope their child will grow to embody god listens and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_hebrew.name: שמעון
in_hebrew.meaning: הוא שמע וקיבל את דבר ה'
in_hebrew.long_meaning: שמעון הוא שם עברי שפירושו 'הוא שמע' או 'אללה שמע'. השם נגזר מהשורש 'שמע' שפירושו לשמוע או לקבל את דבר ה'. בשם שמעון מובע הרעיון של שמיעה וקבלת דבר ה' ברצון ובהכנעה. היסטורית, השם שמעון היה נפוץ בקרב יהודים ומאוחר יותר אומץ גם על ידי נוצרים כסימן לשמיעה וקבלת דבר האל.

in_greek.name: Σίμων
in_greek.long_meaning: Ο Σίμων είναι η ελληνική μορφή του ονόματος שמעון (Shimon) που σημαίνει 'ακουσμένος από τον Θεό' ή 'αυτός που ακούει τον Θεό'. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, ο Σίμων αναφέρεται ως ένας από τους αποστόλους του Ιησού Χριστού, γνωστός και ως Πέτρος μετά την Πεντηκοστή. Ο Σίμων συμβολίζει την ακρόαση και την υπακοή στο λόγο του Θεού.

in_latin.name: Simon
in_latin.meaning: He who hears, heard by God
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Simon is derived from the Hebrew name שמעון (Shimon), meaning 'he who hears' or 'heard by God'. In the Latin tradition, Simon signifies one who listens to God's word and responds in faith. Throughout Christian history, the name Simon has been associated with apostleship and the spreading of the Gospel.

in_english.name: Szymon
in_english.meaning: He who hears, listened to by God
in_english.long_meaning: The name Szymon, derived from the Hebrew שמעון (Shimon), carries the meaning 'he who hears' or 'listened to by God'. This name, popular in Christian traditions, symbolizes a person who is attentive to God's word and will. Historically, Szymon is linked to Saint Simon, one of Jesus' twelve apostles, later known as Saint Peter. The name conveys spiritual attentiveness and devotion.

data.spiritual_significance: The name Szymon holds deep spiritual significance as it is derived from the biblical character Simon Peter, who was the first disciple to confess Jesus as the Christ and was later given the name Peter, which means 'rock'. This name continues to inspire followers of Christianity to be steadfast in their faith and to listen attentively to the words of God.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Szymon, meaning "God is hearing," is a name that carries the promise of Divine attentiveness and listening ears. It encourages those named thus to trust in God's boundless love and compassion, knowing that their prayers are always heard.
